method: Purposive convenience sample of 10 distinct employers, not representative labor-market statistics. Employer-hosted postings only. Some descriptions were recovered from search-indexed primary pages because live ATS rendering was blocked; these are not asserted live-open. Skills are paraphrased from explicit duties/requirements, not inferred. Required vs preferred is stated where material.
